asked: Given a customer selects a 'haircut', the system reserves a 30-minute block in the calendar.
Given a customer selects a 'haircut and beard', the system reserves a 45-minute block in the calendar.
Given a customer selects 'any barber', the system assigns the appointment to the first available barber.
tests: tests/e2e/bookings.spec.ts › a customer books a free time on the public page without an account: provides name, email and phone, the booking is created and a confirmation email with a cancel link is sent
planCriteria.criterion: A customer books a free time on the public page without an account and the booking is created
Given a customer selects a specific barber, the system only shows availability for that individual.

asked: Given a customer completes a booking, a confirmation email is sent containing a unique cancellation link.
tests: tests/e2e/bookings.spec.ts › a customer books a free time on the public page without an account: provides name, email and phone, the booking is created and a confirmation email with a cancel link is sent
planCriteria.criterion: A customer books a free time and a confirmation email with a cancel link is sent
Given a cancellation link is clicked more than 6 hours before the appointment, the slot is released.

asked: Given a cancellation link is clicked less than 6 hours before the appointment, the cancellation is denied.
tests: tests/e2e/bookings.spec.ts › a customer cancels the booking with the link of the confirmation email more than the notice hours before the start time; inside the notice period the link is refused
planCriteria.criterion: A customer cancels the booking with the link of the confirmation email before the notice hours; inside the notice period the link is refused
Given a barber views the dashboard, they can see their individual daily and weekly schedule.

asked: Given a barber marks a time period as 'time off', that period is blocked for all customers.
tests: tests/e2e/bookings.spec.ts › a staff member blocks time off to make those time slots unavailable for booking; customers are no longer offered them
planCriteria.criterion: A staff member blocks time off and those time slots are no longer offered for booking

asked: Given an appointment is being booked, the system prevents two customers from booking the same barber at the same time.
tests: tests/e2e/bookings.spec.ts › a customer cannot book a slot already taken: the same time is never booked twice for one team member (double booking prevented)
tests/unit/bookings.test.ts › locks every grid cell a booking covers (database-level double-booking guard)
planCriteria.criterion: A customer cannot book a slot already taken: the same time is never booked twice for one team member (double booking prevented)
